query: SELECT id AS "id!: VfAccountId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND (id > $3) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND ($3 IS NULL) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $2) __ids ORDER BY id ASC
